function runOptional(callback: (value?: number) => void) { callback(); callback(2); }
runOptional(value => { const result: number = value ?? 0; console.log(result); });
runOptional(() => console.log("ignored"));
const optionalCallback: (value?: number) => void = value => console.log(value ?? 3);
optionalCallback();
optionalCallback(4);
interface OptionalMethod { method(value?: number): void; }
const methods: OptionalMethod = { method(value: number) { console.log(value); } };
methods.method();
methods.method(5);
